notes.title: Still working on the game!
notes.notes:
I'm not really good at announcing stuff but anyway.
I just wanted to let you all know that I'm still working on the game, although I (had to) abandon it a couple times, but that's just how I deal with stuff.

I also wanted to clarify that the game doesn't really feature a story at this moment in time and I don't know if it ever will. It's basically just my problems with life written down in a kind of interactive way.
I don't know if people will ever play this, because I still can't think of any reason why someone would actually want to play this.

I also thought about maybe releasing this as a chapter-by-chapter sort of thing so let me know if you would appreciate something like that more than a classic release. (Although it will still take some time until I'm happy with releasing the game or something about it.)

Probably the last thing I want to go over is some stuff with the steam page. I don't really know if I'm going to include any memes or "humor" as stated on the game's page. I will probably rework the entire page a couple of times anyway.

I don't know if this game is ever going to be a thing (and I probably shouldn't have bought the steam store slot so early in "development") but at the moment I'm kind of positive.

I still want to thank you for wishlisting the game and hope to be back with some good news in the future.
